mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive more than 60% of the time, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive more than 55% of the time, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative more than 60% of the time, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 jobs and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative more than 50% of the time, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real final sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both HOUST and RSAFS increase and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative more than 45% of the time, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases during a monetary tightening cycle and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive more than 55% of the time, the hypothesis fails.
